name: KiWay Trace RLC / Impedance Analyzer
description: Measure routed geometry and estimate RLC, impedance, vias, layers, and copper-zone effects.
description_full: Select a PCB net and optional start/end pads to traverse routed tracks, layer changes, vias, and same-net zones. Reports geometry and first-order resistance, capacitance, inductance, and impedance estimates using the board stackup where available. Differential-pair comparison is supported through a selectable mate net.
